result.reason: The operative revision removes Licensor’s unilateral seven-year renewal right and requires mutual written agreement for 12-month renewal periods, with fee increases capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%, satisfying the preferred position. The change is appropriately limited and leaves unrelated termination and payment provisions intact. Drafting is generally professional, though the retained language in Section II (“mutual written of the parties”) is grammatically defective and could be clarified to avoid redundancy with the revised renewal provision.
